description: Step-by-step business formation, licensing, vendor setup, operations compliance, and 90-day launch timeline for opening a med spa or aesthetic practice.
targetBuyer: Nurse practitioners, PAs, and aestheticians planning to open their own med spa or aesthetic suite

templates.name: Med Spa Business Formation Checklist
templates.description: Entity type, state registration, EIN, banking, insurance, and collaborative practice requirements

templates.name: Licensing & Credentialing Checklist
templates.description: NPI, DEA, state licenses, local permits, OSHA, ADA, and facility inspections

templates.name: Vendor & Supplier Setup Checklist
templates.description: Medical supplies, product lines, EMR, payment processing, and marketing tools

templates.name: Operations & Compliance Setup Checklist
templates.description: HIPAA, consent forms, emergency protocols, infection control, and staff training

templates.name: 90-Day Med Spa Launch Timeline
templates.description: Month-by-month milestone checklist from formation through grand opening

deliveryNote: Requirements vary by state. Use these checklists as a planning framework and verify all licensing and legal requirements with your state board and attorney.
